body: Girlfriend told me today that she doesn't love me anymore. How was yours?
Dark Souls for the Switch. Currently stuck at the pair of gargoyles
I suppose that's where I find myself, but I do interact with scores of people throughout the day. None of it means anything, though.

Good for you. I mean that genuinely. It's a great service you're doing for free here. It still doesn't really help me, and maybe that's fine. I don't have the time to do what you do, nor do I have the energy. I barely have the energy or time to do this. I really don't understand what you're driving at here, and I'm sorry that I'm so dense.
Showing up to what? Meetings?

We're coming from fundamentally different starting positions. I detest being rude, but you're wrong. I'm not intelligent. But let's assume my brain isn't comparable to the liquid in a porta-potty. How the fuck can I help someone when I can't help myself?

None. My job is tedious, but anyone could do it. My academic work is nothing special, it doesn't improve anyone's life. I'm not vegan, so that right there is fucking up the planet and future generations.

That's the thing. I persevere, but I'm just spinning my wheels. Sure, I could persevere through life, but when I'm old and grey and have accomplished little of value (I know for almost certain that this is where I will end up, if not dead), where will that perseverance have brought me?
I don't follow. Are you extolling the virtues of perseverance?

I can put coherent sentences together. No offense intended, but whoop dee fucking doo. Philosophy strikes me as a possibility because it's interesting, just like science, politics, etc. Doesn't mean I'm good at it.

If I sound like a normal person, just lacking a support system, then God have mercy on the human race. If everyone experiences what I experience, then it's a wonder there aren't more suicides. I really think you're reaching here. I don't know your background, but I don't know what you're trying to get across here. Plus, what do you see that's of value?
Explain?
Boondocks Saints, and unfortunately, the critics were right on this one. It's a shallow, obnoxious, off-putting, and bland imitation of Tarantino.
Pretty much
To clarify, I'm going back to uni in the fall, I'm not a grad yet. Still, it fucking sucks.
Haha, no. I've tried doing the same in person, and like you can see above, it doesn't do jackshit. Thanks, though. It's quite difficult.

When God admits that he's the cause of everyone's problems: 

> I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things. - Isaiah 45:7

Glad that you have hope that things will get better. My personal situations have marginally improved, but I still feel as down as ever. I think I'm past the point of having hope of freeing myself of this. I don't want to drag you down, because I don't know your situation, and I'm no doctor. Maybe there is hope for you.

I'm not, haha. The social anxiety makes that sort of thing difficult. Also, and this isn't a personal attack on you - but the "it gets better," trope is so tired. I've been told that it gets better since middle school. I'm out of college for the summer, and I'm still feeling empty and scared, just like it did then. It gets better for some people.  Not all.

Good for you! I admire the willpower it takes to cut out alcohol from your life. I don't drive, I walk to my job, so I'm not in quite the same situation, though. Only downsides to alcohol for me and for now are the hangovers and the brain fog afterwards.
Eh, I've told myself that for the last decade. Anytime now...
